evidence: Carries the Validation label and refactors core chainstate APIs across src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: Removes a major architectural hazard where BlockValidationState conflated consensus/policy invalidity with system and runtime failures. As noted in the problem statement, non-validating routines such as FlushStateToDisk and InvalidateBlock were previously forced to take validation out-parameters solely for runtime errors, and this refactoring directly enables follow-up work in #35570.
